from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as it appears in the text")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
